Name: Agent Deck
Author: HyeonBeom Yi

Actions.Name: Agent Session
Actions.Tooltip: Shows one Claude Code / Codex session as an animated mascot (working, sleeping, done, waiting). Press to jump to its window.

Actions.Name: Next Waiting
Actions.Tooltip: Counts sessions waiting on you. Press to jump to the most urgent one.

Actions.Name: System Monitor
Actions.Tooltip: CPU and RAM usage, refreshed every second. Press to open Task Manager.

Actions.Name: Claude App
Actions.Tooltip: Brings the Claude desktop app to the front, starting it if it is not running.

Actions.Name: Claude Here
Actions.Tooltip: Opens a Windows Terminal tab with WSL in the focused Explorer folder and starts claude.

Description: One key per Claude Code / Codex session: an animated Claude mascot shows what the session is doing, press to jump to its window. Plus a CPU / RAM monitor key.
